newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Agan Q1 EPS 2.27 shekels.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Agan Q1 EPS 2.27 shekels.

text.p: Israel's Agan Chemical Manufacturers Ltd, a subsidiary of Makhteshim Chemical Works

NOTE - Agan, a maker of crop-protection and aroma chemicals, said its recently acquired Latin American operations were responsible both for the increased revenues and the decline in profitability in the first quarter.
Sales to Latin America were up 74 percent from a year earlier to $24.7 million, but because Latin American sales are much slower in the first half profit margins for Agan fell.

"The operations of the three South American companies are characterised by very strong seasonality," Agan said. "Most of their sales (more than 75 percent) occur in August-December. All the consolidated companies operated according to forecasts."
The company added that first-quarter results were helped by the strength of the dollar against European currencies, which reduced raw materials costs.
